question.text: A body of mass $2 \mathrm{~kg}$ slides down with an acceleration of $3 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^2$ on a rough inclined plane having a slope of $30^{\circ}$. The external force required to take the same body up the plane with the same acceleration will be: $\left(\mathrm{g}=10 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^2\right)$
